ko.theme_desc: 달콤한 유혹에 빠진 인류, 붕어빵의 끈적한 촉수에 속절없이 사로잡히고 있다. 곧 붕어빵 공장에서 강제 노동을 하게 될지도.

scenarios.10y: 붕어빵 군단의 노예가 돼서, 매일 팥 앙금 똥꼬쇼를 해야 한대.
scenarios.20y: 붕어빵 공장 지하에서 탈출했는데, 알고 보니 붕어빵계의 대통령이 되네?
scenarios.30y: 붕어빵을 위한, 붕어빵에 의한, 붕어빵 세상에서, 붕어빵보다 잘나가는 인싸가 됐어!

en.theme_title: ⚠️ Warning: The Great Fish-Shaped Pastry Assimilation!
en.theme_desc: Humans are falling prey to the delicious allure of fish-shaped pastries, ensnared by their sticky embrace. Forced labor in the pastry factories looms.

scenarios.10y: You're now a slave to the Fish-Shaped Bun Brigade, forced to perform red bean paste butt dances daily.
scenarios.20y: You escaped the fish-shaped bun factory basement, only to become the fish-shaped bun world's president?
scenarios.30y: In a world ruled by fish-shaped buns, you became the biggest trendsetter, even bigger than the buns themselves!
